scope: Standalone raster OCR arithmetic; manual source review plus automated adversarial and real-backend checks

tests.normal_without_backend_environment: 16 pass and 2 real OCR integration tests skipped

actual_demonstration.source_pixels_contain_program: Numbers, operators and parentheses are read from glyph pixels and interpreted as bounded AST; results are not supplied by metadata

fixed_findings: Executable/model configuration was tied to one host and a sibling tessdata directory; explicit and environment-based paths now supported.
Evidence paths could overwrite or expose source context; unique inherited-permission folders and exact source snapshots now used.
Process output and TSV tokens lacked tight limits; bounded subprocess polling, deadlines and token validation added.
Unicode glyph substitutions and confidence-only selection could conceal a wrong expression; strict ASCII syntax and all-pass structure consensus now gate computation.
Duplicate/missing pass identities or invalid geometry could pass insufficient validation; explicit evidence shape checks added.
Full frame-count queries could scan arbitrarily many frames; scan bounded to first 33 frames.
Failed TIFF seek can leave stale page metadata; reset to page zero before selecting final frame.
Result-export failure could leave a premature success receipt; accepted status is now set only after both output carriers verify.
limitations: Unanimous OCR passes may share the same mistake.
Inherited confidence is heuristic; this release does not establish CER/WER improvement or searchable-PDF/plug-in ABI behavior.
Tesseract is a trusted separately installed executable; process/file limits are monitored, not an OS security sandbox.
File output can briefly exceed the cap between 25ms polls.
Actual backend validation used one Tesseract build, one English model and synthetic glyph fixtures.
No physical optical computation or full Penteract release qualification is claimed.

processable_image_criterion.image_program: visible glyph operators, constants, parentheses and comparisons
processable_image_criterion.input: pixel rectangle selected by fixed checksummed raster header
processable_image_criterion.execution: actual Tesseract 5 -> all-pass AST structure agreement -> generic bounded AST interpreter
processable_image_criterion.output: computed result TIFF/GIF with original program glyph pixels preserved on every frame
